senses.gloss: warm and moist (of a fresh stripped hide).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 79a">Sabb. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>התם בבו׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בבישולה</he>, early ed. <he>בבושלה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) there a fresh hide is meant (not dry enough for the first process of tanning).

<cite ref="Berakhot 40b:23">Ber. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ כומרא</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="K00819"><he>כמרא</he></cite>) figs ripened by shrinking (placed in the ground, Ar., overripe through exposure to the sun; Rashi).
